news.title: Carlo Cudicini interview: Sunderland saves, penalty record and personal honour
news.title_zh: 卡洛·库迪奇尼专访：桑德兰扑救、点球记录和个人荣誉
news.body_en: With the 25th anniversary of a legendary performance from Carlo Cudicini away to Sunderland approaching, we caught up with the former Chelsea goalkeeper ahead of this weekend's visit to Wearside... Earlier this year, Carlo Cudicini was asked a simple question that was far from easy to answer. ‘What was your best performance in a Chelsea shirt?’ The passage of time dictates that memories fade, but those that linger burn the brightest. You could almost see Cudicini whirring through his 200-plus games for the Blues, from his debut in August 1999 to his final appearance for us nearly ten years later. Eventually, he settled on a ‘game at Sunderland, a goalless draw’. For a man who represented Chelsea with such distinction – in high-profile Premier League games, FA Cup finals, Champions League classics – a 0-0 at the Stadium of Light on a wintry December afternoon might be considered an inauspicious response. Watch back the highlights, though, and you get the sense of a goalkeeper at the very top of his game. Kevin Phillips, one of the Premier League’s top strikers at the turn of the century, is denied on three occasions, including from the penalty spot followed by an improbable save with the Italian’s feet from a few yards out. ‘It was probably related more to feeling than anything else,’ Cudicini, now Chelsea’s head of talent and pathways, tells us at Cobham this week when we enquire about that Sunderland performance. ‘Most of the time, a player or a keeper’s performance is just judged on whether he scores or saves, but I think it’s more related to what the feeling was during the game. And that day, there was just no way they were scoring a goal. ‘That was the feeling I probably developed throughout the game, after making the first save. It’s all about momentum. And as well I loved to play away, because you get the feeling the opponents keep coming, you keep saving, and the supporters get frustrated because it’s like going up against a wall.’ Cudicini can recall only a handful of occasions throughout his career when he felt truly unbeatable. The Sunderland game 25 years ago was one of them, and an important factor behind Cudicini’s inner belief that he would not concede was the way he got in Phillips’ head. ‘A big part of being a goalkeeper is the psychological battle with the striker, without a doubt,’ Cudicini explains. ‘If on one side you feel unbeatable, on the other you frustrate the striker who can only say: “What do I have to do?” ‘That gets in their mind. They can overthink it and there’s a component in there saying: “Maybe I’m trying too hard to score.”’ Cudicini remembers a sense of personal pride and satisfaction with his performance at the Stadium of Light, but in the context of the season, it was two points dropped. Claudio Ranieri’s Blues had aspirations of finishing in the top four. Unfortunately, inconsistency continued to plague us. A week prior to the Sunderland game, we took the champions Manchester United apart at Old Trafford, a clinic of counter-attacking football securing a famous 3-0 success. But that was followed by a 1-0 loss at home to lowly Charlton, and then the goalless draw on Wearside. The next weekend, we thrashed top-of-the-table Liverpool 4-0. Cudicini saved yet another penalty in that game, this time from Gary McAllister. His stop from Darren Bent’s spot-kick the following April means he is a member of an exclusive club to have saved a record three penalties in a single Premier League season. ‘Obviously you need a bit of luck, but there were probably two main points to my penalty record,’ reflects Cudicini, who would deny Ruud van Nistelrooy and Thierry Henry from 12 yards later in his Chelsea career. ‘One was my characteristics as a goalkeeper. Not being the tallest meant I was very elastic, very springy, very reactive, and with penalties you need that, because a centimetre can be the difference. ‘At the same time, I did a lot of research at a time when we didn’t have data, like a goalkeeper coach coming in the day before the match saying, “Those are where he took the last ten penalties”. I played at the wrong time for that! ‘I started the work during pre-season, watching every friendly where a lot of times it finished with penalties. I would take notes. Then, during the season, I would watch every episode of Match of the Day, looking at the penalties, what minute they were in, the scoreline, where it was going. ‘So I was going into games having my philosophy around that, based on research I had done, and that year it worked brilliantly.’ The 2001/02 campaign culminated with Cudicini becoming just the fourth goalkeeper to win the Chelsea Player of the Season award. That was no mean feat, partly because Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Eidur Gudjohnsen formed a deadly strike partnership that year, scoring a remarkable 52 goals between them. Not only that, but Cudicini didn’t actually establish himself in the Chelsea starting XI until two weeks before the draw at Sunderland. A pre-season injury handed Ed de Goey a place back between the posts on the opening day, and then when the Dutchman’s form dipped, Ranieri turned to Mark Bosnich. It wasn’t until he tore a thigh muscle late on in a goalless draw at Goodison Park that Cudicini was handed his chance. It was one he grabbed with both hands, registering six clean sheets in his first seven games back, not least because of that pair of penalty saves in consecutive weeks. ‘I was disappointed because I thought I’d done enough the season before to start again when I was fit. Mark had a couple of good games, so I understood that, but I was disappointed. ‘I was training very well and thinking that surely it had to change. As a goalkeeper, you either play or you don’t. You can’t come on for 20 minutes. But when Mark got injured, I stepped in. That’s how it works for goalkeepers. ‘I remember I had such huge energy after the Everton game. I came on for Mark and made a good save right at the end to keep it 0-0. All that frustration at not playing built up, and then that good energy and good feeling from the game brought me momentum.’ Cudicini’s presence between the posts proved pivotal in the Blues securing a sixth-placed finish and with it, European football for the following campaign. We did well in the domestic cups, too, reaching the semi-finals of the League Cup and then the final of the FA Cup. Alas, our north London rivals put paid to our hopes of silverware, but our No.23 did still end the season with a trophy in his hands. ‘The Player of the Year didn’t exist at that time in Italy,’ Cudicini says. ‘I remember my first year when I joined Chelsea, and there was the Player of the Year, and I was asking Roberto [Di Matteo], Gianfranco [Zola], obviously Italian guys: "What is this all about?” ‘They explained to me, so I understood its importance. So when I was awarded one, it was a great honour. I was really proud of the relationship that I managed to build with the fans. ‘Personally, that season was probably the most important in my career at Chelsea,' adds Cudicini. 'Coming from Castel di Sangro for £150,000, being alone, not playing at the start, it was all the build-up to that season. ‘A lot of it was down to my relationship with the fans, I think. Coming from Italy, you're passionate, so you get agitated, you get upset, you celebrate with the fans. That was the bond we had.’ As much as memories fade, the image of Cudicini clenching his fists and roaring with joy after saving a penalty will live in Chelsea supporters’ minds for a long while yet.
news.body_zh: 随着卡洛·库迪奇尼客场对阵桑德兰的传奇表演 25 周年纪念日的临近，我们在本周末造访威尔赛德之前采访了这位前切尔西门将……今年早些时候，卡洛·库迪奇尼被问到了一个简单的问题，但这个问题很难回答。 “你身披切尔西球衣的最佳表现是什么？”随着时间的流逝，记忆会逐渐淡去，但那些挥之不去的记忆却最为明亮。从 1999 年 8 月的首秀到近十年后他为我们出场的最后一场比赛，你几乎可以看到库迪奇尼为蓝军效力的 200 多场比赛。最终，他选择了“对阵桑德兰的比赛，一场互交白卷”。对于一个代表切尔西队在备受瞩目的英超比赛、足总杯决赛、欧冠经典赛中表现出色的人来说，在12月寒冷的下午在光明球场以0-0的比分可能会被认为是一个不吉利的回应。不过，回顾一下精彩片段，你就会感受到一名守门员在比赛中处于巅峰状态的感觉。凯文·菲利普斯是世纪之交英超联赛的顶级前锋之一，他曾三次被挡出球门，其中包括在点球点上被意大利人在几码外用脚不可思议地扑出。 “这可能更多地与感觉有关，而不是其他任何事情，”库迪奇尼，现任切尔西人才和途径主管，本周在科巴姆询问桑德兰的表现时告诉我们。 “大多数时候，一个球员或守门员的表现只是根据他是否进球或扑救来判断，但我认为这更与比赛时的感觉有关。那天，他们根本不可能进球。 “这就是我在完成第一次扑救后在整场比赛中产生的感觉。这一切都与动力有关。我也喜欢在客场比赛，因为你会感觉到对手不断涌来，你不断救球，而支持者会感到沮丧，因为这就像撞墙一样。”库迪奇尼记得在他的职业生涯中，只有少数几次他感到真正不可战胜。 25年前对阵桑德兰的比赛就是其中之一，而库迪奇尼内心坚信自己不会失球的一个重要因素就是他在菲利普斯脑海中的表现方式。 “毫无疑问，作为守门员的一个重要部分是与前锋的心理斗争，”库迪奇尼解释道。 “如果一方面你感觉自己不可战胜，另一方面你又让前锋感到沮丧，他只能说：“我必须做什么？” '这进入了他们的脑海。他们可能会想太多，其中有一个成分在说：“也许我太努力得分了。”库迪奇尼记得他在光明球场的表现有一种个人自豪感和满足感，但在本赛季的背景下，丢了两分。克劳迪奥·拉涅利的蓝军渴望进入前四。不幸的是，不一致继续困扰着我们。对阵桑德兰的比赛前一周，我们在老特拉福德球场击败了冠军曼联，这是一场反击足球的诊所，最终以 3-0 取得了著名的胜利。但随后他们在主场0-1输给了弱旅查尔顿，然后又0比0战平威尔赛德。接下来的周末，我们以 4-0 击败了积分榜榜首的利物浦。库迪奇尼在那场比赛中再次扑出了加里·麦卡利斯特的点球。第二年四月，他在达伦·本特的点球中被扑出，这意味着他是一个在英超单赛季扑出了创纪录的三个点球的俱乐部的成员。 “显然你需要一点运气，但我的点球记录可能有两个要点，”库迪奇尼回忆道，在他的切尔西生涯后期，他在 12 码处挡出了范尼斯特鲁伊和蒂埃里·亨利。 “其中之一是我作为守门员的特点。不是最高的意味着我非常有弹性，非常有弹性，非常反应性，并且在处罚中你需要这一点，因为一厘米可能会有所不同。 “与此同时，在我们没有数据的情况下，我做了很多研究，就像比赛前一天守门员教练说的那样，‘这些是他最后十个点球的地方’。我玩错时间了！ “我在季前赛期间就开始了这项工作，观看了每一场友谊赛，很多时候都是以点球结束。我会做笔记。然后，在整个赛季中，我会观看每日比赛的每一集，查看点球大战、比赛进行到哪一分钟、比分、以及进展情况。 “因此，根据我所做的研究，我在比赛中秉持着自己的理念，那一年效果非常出色。” 2001/02 赛季，库迪奇尼成为第四位获得切尔西赛季最佳球员奖的门将。这绝非易事，部分原因是吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和埃杜尔·古德约翰森当年组成了致命的锋线搭档，两人共打进了 52 个进球。不仅如此，库迪奇尼直到对阵桑德兰的抽签前两周才真正跻身切尔西首发阵容。季前赛的伤病让埃德·德·戈伊在开幕日回到了门柱之间，然后当荷兰人的状态下滑时，拉涅利转向马克·博斯尼奇。直到在古迪逊公园球场的一场0-0平局中，库迪奇尼在最后时刻大腿肌肉撕裂，才得到了机会。这是他用双手抓住的机会，在他回归的前七场比赛中六场不失球，尤其是因为连续几周的两次点球扑救。 “我很失望，因为我以为自己在上个赛季已经做得足够了，可以在身体健康时重新开始。马克打了几场精彩的比赛，所以我理解这一点，但我很失望。 “我训练得很好，我想这肯定需要改变。作为守门员，你要么上场，要么不上场。 20分钟内你不能上场。但当马克受伤时，我介入了。这就是守门员的工作方式。 “我记得在与埃弗顿的比赛后我充满了能量。我替补了马克，并在比赛最后时刻做出了精彩扑救，将比分改写为0-0。所有因无法上场而感到的挫败感逐渐累积起来，然后比赛中的良好能量和良好感觉给我带来了动力。库迪奇尼在门柱之间的存在证明了蓝军获得第六名以及随后赛季的欧洲足球的关键。我们在国内杯赛上也取得了不错的成绩，联赛杯打进了半决赛，足总杯也打进了决赛。唉，我们北伦敦的对手让我们获得奖杯的希望落空了，但我们的 23 号球员仍然手里拿着一座奖杯结束了赛季。 “当时意大利还没有年度最佳球员，”库迪奇尼说。 “我记得我加入切尔西的第一年，有年度最佳球员，我问罗伯托（迪马特奥）、吉安弗兰科（佐拉），显然是意大利人：“这到底是怎么回事？ “他们向我解释，所以我明白了它的重要性。因此，当我获得这一奖项时，我感到非常荣幸。我对我与粉丝建立的关系感到非常自豪。 “就我个人而言，那个赛季可能是我在切尔西的职业生涯中最重要的一个赛季，”库迪奇尼补充道。 “以15万英镑的身价从桑格罗堡来到这里，独自一人，一开始就没有参加比赛，这都是为那个赛季做的准备。 “我认为这很大程度上取决于我与球迷的关系。来自意大利，你充满激情，所以你会变得焦躁、不安，你会和球迷一起庆祝。这就是我们之间的纽带。”尽管记忆渐渐淡去，但库迪奇尼在扑出点球后握紧拳头、欢呼雀跃的形象将在切尔西球迷的脑海中长期存在。

news.title: Melvine Malard on why there's even more to come from her at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 讲述为何她在切尔西会取得更多成就
news.body_en: Melvine Malard has hit the ground running at Chelsea. Our new number nine has scored eight goals in seven starts and three substitute appearances since signing from Manchester United this summer. Little wonder, then, she is our top scorer so far. Last season, she netted six times in 21 league outings for the Red Devils, but she has now equalled that tally in her first six WSL games with Chelsea. When we sit down with the France international, we mention how her strike rate has so clearly improved. We then ask her what she attributes her good form to, but her answer comes as a surprise. Six goals in six league games, and Malard feels we haven't seen anything yet. ‘I don’t think I’m in my good form yet; that’s the thing,’ she says with a huge smile. ‘Not yet. ‘When you play with a lot of quality individuals, it can help you a lot. Having a positive vibe in your head can also help you a lot. I just need to keep going to reach my top form. ‘What I understand more now with the number nine role is you need to have a lot of patience, and you need to be ready in the box when players give you the ball.’ Malard has settled in so quickly to life at Chelsea. She talks about positivity, and she certainly brings the vibes around the training ground and on the pitch. The time has flown since her arrival in July, and she gives us some insight into the team’s hectic schedule and how she stays focused on the task in front of her. ‘It’s busy, very busy,’ she explains. ‘We play a lot of games with big intensity against a lot of quality players, so it’s busy but very good. ‘When you play well, you feel good, and you win. Also, you score goals. That's my job. I’m very happy to be here and to be doing my job at the moment. I’m taking it game by game. We have a lot of matches, with the Champions League and the national team and everything like that. ‘My job is to help the team when I can: to take responsibility, and take the opportunities I have in front of goal and don’t overthink things. If you make sure you play with passion, you enjoy your football and score the goals. ‘You can see that many people can score in this team, so I don’t worry about it. With good team-mates around you, you know you can have a lot of opportunities, a lot of action in front of goal and okay, if you miss that one, the next player will give you another ball to try again.’ Malard played for Sonia Bompastor from the age of 14. After making the move from her home on the island of La Reunion in the Indian Ocean to play for Lyon, she is now in her second spell under Bompastor and details how the head coach has evolved since then. ‘Sonia is the same,’ she says. ‘The same coach demanding a lot. She’s very exigent with you and your quality. But it’s good to have a coach that pushes you a lot and makes sure you don’t become complacent. ‘She’s maybe a little bit more relaxed here. She shows more happiness. We know in England it’s very free, so she can speak her mind. It’s good to feel free.’ This Saturday sees Chelsea host Everton at Stamford Bridge in the WSL. When we ask her what we can expect, the striker pauses and gives us a thoughtful answer on what a fast start could mean for her team-mates. It’s evident she cares very much about the collective. ‘Everton also have good players, good quality,’ she says when asked about the opposition. ‘They play direct, and when they have the opportunity to shoot, they are not scared to do it, no matter who is in front of them. 'We need to make sure we are always focused on every ball and every player. We want to score quickly. We saw against Charlton that when we score quickly in the first half, we can also allow other players to enjoy the game, like Giulia (Dragoni). 'When she scored her first, she had a lot of emotion because the team did their jobs in the first half and gave her the chance to show her football. If we can do that in every game, it's good for our team, and everyone is happy.' Malard isn’t the kind of player who wants to talk at length about individual accolades. When we ask her about attending last month’s Ballon d’Or ceremony, she once again relates being ranked 28th in the world to how it rewarded the most important people in her life. ‘It was amazing,’ she says. ‘You sacrifice a lot in your life to become a footballer, so it’s special when you are nominated. I went with my wife and my mum. It was a big thank you very much for all the help they have given me in my life. ‘But we need to keep going to be nominated again. Because football is not easy. I went to the ceremony, but now it’s done. We need to move on and keep working hard. ‘I’d like to get higher up the list, but there is a lot of talent so the places are tight. You just need to keep doing your best.’ See Melvine and the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 在切尔西已经崭露头角。自从今年夏天从曼联加盟以来，我们的新九号在七场首发和三场替补出场中打进了八个进球。难怪她是我们迄今为止的最佳得分手。上赛季，她在代表红魔出战的 21 场联赛中攻入 6 球，但现在她在代表切尔西的前六场 WSL 比赛中追平了这一进球数。当我们与这位法国国脚坐下来时，我们提到她的进球率如何明显提高。然后我们问她，她将自己的良好状态归因于什么，但她的回答令人惊讶。六场联赛中的六个进球，马拉德觉得我们还没有看到任何东西。 “我认为我的状态还不是很好；就是这样，”她笑着说道。 '还没有。 “当你和很多优秀的人一起踢球时，这会对你有很大帮助。头脑中保持积极的氛围也会对你有很大帮助。我只需要继续达到我的最佳状态。 “我现在对九号角色更了解的是，你需要有很大的耐心，当球员给你球时，你需要在禁区内做好准备。”马拉德很快就适应了切尔西的生活。她谈论积极性，她确实给训练场和球场带来了积极的氛围。自她七月份到来以来，时间过得真快，她向我们介绍了团队繁忙的日程以及她如何专注于眼前的任务。 “很忙，非常忙，”她解释道。 “我们与很多优秀的球员进行了很多高强度的比赛，所以很忙碌，但非常好。 “当你打得好的时候，你感觉很好，你就会赢。此外，你还能进球。这就是我的工作。我很高兴来到这里并做好我现在的工作。我会逐场比赛。我们有很多比赛，包括冠军联赛和国家队等等。 “我的工作是尽我所能帮助球队：承担责任，抓住进球前的机会，不要想得太多。如果你确保自己充满激情地踢球，你就会享受足球并进球。 ‘你可以看到这支球队里有很多人都能进球，所以我不担心。有了优秀的队友在你身边，你知道你可以有很多机会，在球门前有很多动作，好吧，如果你错过了那个机会，下一个球员会给你另一个球，让你再试一次。”马拉德从 14 岁起就为索尼娅·邦帕斯托效力。在从印度洋留尼汪岛的家搬到里昂效力后，她现在是在邦帕斯托的第二次执教，并详细介绍了主教练自那以后是如何发展的。 “索尼娅也是一样，”她说。 “同一个教练要求很高。她对你和你的品质非常严格。但有一位教练会不断鞭策你并确保你不会自满，这是件好事。 “她在这里可能更放松一点。她表现出更多的幸福。我们知道在英国这是非常自由的，所以她可以说出自己的想法。自由的感觉真好。” 本周六，WSL 切尔西将在斯坦福桥迎战埃弗顿。当我们问她我们可以期待什么时，这位前锋停了下来，给了我们一个深思熟虑的答案，说明快速启动对她的队友意味着什么。看得出来她非常关心集体。 “埃弗顿也有优秀的球员，素质很高，”当被问及对手时她说道。 “他们打球直接，当他们有机会射门时，他们不会害怕这样做，无论他们面前的是谁。 “我们需要确保我们始终专注于每个球和每个球员。我们想要快速得分。我们在对阵查尔顿的比赛中看到，当我们在上半场快速得分时，我们也可以让其他球员享受比赛，比如朱利亚（德拉戈尼）。 “当她打进第一个进球时，她非常激动，因为球队在上半场完成了自己的工作，给了她展示足球的机会。如果我们能在每场比赛中做到这一点，这对我们的球队有好处，每个人都会很高兴。”马拉德并不是那种愿意详细谈论个人荣誉的球员。当我们问她参加上个月的金球奖颁奖典礼时，她再次谈到了世界排名第 28 位是如何奖励她生命中最重要的人的。 “太棒了，”她说。 “为了成为一名足球运动员，你在生活中牺牲了很多，所以当你被提名时，这是很特别的。我和我的妻子和妈妈一起去的。非常感谢他们在我的生活中给予我的所有帮助。 “但我们需要继续再次获得提名。因为足球并不容易。我参加了仪式，但现在已经结束了。我们需要继续前进并继续努力。 “我想在名单上排名更高，但人才很多，所以位置很紧张。你只需要继续尽力而为。”观看梅尔文和蓝军周六在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的比赛！门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: October Chelsea Goal of the Month winner revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西十月最佳进球得主揭晓！
news.body_en: For the second month in a row, Morgan Rogers has received the Chelsea Goal of the Month award. Since joining the Blues from Aston Villa in the summer, Rogers has now won two of the three Goal of the Month awards available, including the last two in a row. That has come during a brilliant start to his Chelsea career, which has seen him become the first Blues player – and only the second across the entire Premier League – to reach ten goal involvements (six goals, four assists) in all competitions this season. His two award-winning goals showed very different qualities, too. In September, it was for his instinctive volley into the bottom corner from the edge of the box away at Arsenal. This time around, he finished top of the October poll thanks to his opener against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, taking the ball from Romeo Lavia near the centre-circle and driving forward through the heart of the defence and into the box, before lifting a composed finish over the keeper. It was a tight race for the October Goal of the Month award, though. Jordan Henderson’s first Chelsea goal, swept in against Bournemouth, came second with 34 per cent of the votes, while the midfielder’s free-kick scored later in the same game was a distant third. However, it is Rogers who triumphs for the second month in a row by receiving 39 per cent of supporters’ votes on the Chelsea Official App.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯连续第二个月荣获切尔西月度最佳进球奖。自从今年夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟蓝军以来，罗杰斯现在已经赢得了三个月度最佳进球奖中的两个，包括连续两个奖项。这是他在切尔西职业生涯的辉煌开局之际实现的，这让他成为本赛季第一个在所有比赛中打入 10 粒进球（6 个进球，4 次助攻）的蓝军球员，也是整个英超联赛中第二个。他的两个获奖进球也表现出了截然不同的品质。 9月，在客场对阵阿森纳的比赛中，他在禁区边缘本能的抽射打入底角。这一次，他凭借在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的首开纪录，在十月份的评选中名列前茅，他从中圈附近的罗密欧·拉维亚手中接过球，向前突破防守中心，进入禁区，然后冷静地越过门将射门。不过，十月最佳进球奖的争夺十分激烈。乔丹·亨德森在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中攻入切尔西的第一个进球，以 34% 的得票率位居第二，而这位中场球员后来在同一场比赛中打进的任意球则远远落后于第三。然而，罗杰斯连续第二个月获胜，在切尔西官方应用程序上获得了 39% 的支持者投票。

news.title: Help Mike Penders win Premier League Save of the Month

news.body_en: Mike Penders has received a nomination for the October Premier League Save of the Month award. Our Belgian goalkeeper only made his Premier League debut two weeks ago, when he came off the bench to replace the injured Emiliano Martinez in the 2-0 win away at Everton. Vote for Mike Penders to win the October Premier League Save of the Month award He continued between the posts for our remaining two league fixtures in October, keeping his first solo clean sheet in the most recent of those, when we beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge. It was in that game that Penders produced the stunning save which has been nominated for the monthly award. He showed quick reflexes and excellent agility to divert Bryan Mbeumo’s powerful drive onto the crossbar with his fingertips late on, keeping his clean sheet intact. Alongside Penders, the other five goalkeepers on the award shortlist are Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa), Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion), Christian Walton (Ipswich Town), Walter Benitez and Dean Henderson (both Crystal Palace). The winner will be decided by a public poll and you can help Penders to claim the October Premier League Save of the Month award by casting your vote here before the deadline of midday on Monday 9 November. The winning goalkeeper will be revealed at 2pm on Friday 13 November.
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯获得十月英超联赛月度拯救奖提名。我们的比利时门将两周前才完成英超首秀，当时他在客场2-0战胜埃弗顿的比赛中替补受伤的埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯出场。投票选举迈克·彭德斯获得十月英超联赛月度最佳扑救奖。十月份我们剩下的两场联赛中，他继续担任门将，在最近的一场比赛中，我们在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败曼联，保持了他的第一次个人零失球。正是在那场比赛中，彭德斯做出了令人惊叹的扑救，并获得了月度奖提名。他表现出快速的反应和出色的敏捷性，最后用指尖将布莱恩·姆博莫的强力射门转移到横梁上，保持了不失球。除彭德斯外，入围名单中的其他五名门将分别是锡安·铃木（阿斯顿维拉）、巴特·维尔布鲁根（布莱顿）、克里斯蒂安·沃尔顿（伊普斯维奇）、沃尔特·贝尼特斯和迪恩·亨德森（均为水晶宫）。获胜者将通过公众投票选出，您可以在 11 月 9 日星期一中午截止日期之前在这里投票，帮助彭德斯获得 10 月份英超联赛最佳拯救奖。获胜门将将于 11 月 13 日星期五下午 2 点揭晓。

news.title: Vote Xabi Alonso for Premier League Manager of the Month
news.title_zh: 投票哈维·阿隆索为本月英超最佳教练
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has been included on the shortlist for the Premier League Manager of the Month award for the second time already this season. Our Spanish manager previously made the shortlist in August, following his first few weeks in the Chelsea dugout, and now receives a nomination for October's award. Vote for Xabi Alonso to win Premier League Manager of the Month It follows a strong month for the Blues, during which we won three of our four league games. That started when we returned from the extended international break with a 5-1 thrashing of Bournemouth, before we took that form on the road to secure our first Premier League clean sheet of the campaign in a 2-0 win at Everton. Following a setback against Tottenham Hotspur, Chelsea got straight back to winning ways on the final day of the month, producing an excellent second-half performance to beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge. Alonso is one of six names on the shortlist for the award, facing competition from Mikel Arteta (Arsenal), Roberto De Zerbi (Tottenham), Unai Emery (Aston Villa), Fabian Hurzeler (Brighton & Hove Albion) and Marco Rose (Bournemouth). You can help the Chelsea manager collect the award by casting your vote for the October Premier League Manager of the Month here before the poll closes at midday on Monday 9 November. The winner will be revealed at midday on Friday 13 November.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索本赛季第二次入围英超月度最佳教练奖候选名单。我们的西班牙主教练在切尔西教练席的头几周后，曾于八月份入围候选名单，现在获得了十月份奖项的提名。投票支持哈维·阿隆索赢得本月英超最佳主教练 蓝军在一个月内表现强劲，在此期间我们赢得了四场联赛中的三场。这一切始于我们结束国际比赛日后以5-1大胜伯恩茅斯的比赛，随后我们在客场以2-0战胜埃弗顿，确保了本赛季首个英超不失球。切尔西队在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中遭遇挫折后，在本月的最后一天重新回到胜利轨道，下半场表现出色，在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败了曼联队。阿隆索是该奖项入围名单中的六名球员之一，面临着米克尔·阿尔特塔（阿森纳）、罗伯托·德泽尔比（托特纳姆热刺）、乌奈·埃梅里（阿斯顿维拉）、法比安·胡尔泽勒（布莱顿）和马可·罗斯（伯恩茅斯）的竞争。您可以在 11 月 9 日星期一中午投票结束之前，在这里投票选出 10 月份英超联赛最佳教练，帮助切尔西主帅领取奖项。获胜者将于 11 月 13 日星期五中午揭晓。

news.title: Chelsea loan report: Essugo, Murray-Campbell and Samuels-Smith impress
news.title_zh: 切尔西租借报告：埃苏戈、穆雷-坎贝尔和萨缪尔斯-史密斯令人印象深刻
news.body_en: Chelsea's players out on loan continued their development across Europe and the English football pyramid during October, with several making important contributions for their temporary clubs. We take a look at how the Blues' loanees performed during the month, with Dario Essugo, Harrison Murray-Campbell and Ishe Samuels-Smith among those catching the eye. Dario Essugo started each of Strasbourg’s three games in October, deployed in the centre of the Ligue 1 side’s midfield. He scored the opening goal, his first for the club, in Strasbourg’s 2-1 defeat to Nice, while also playing the full 90 minutes against European champions Paris Saint-Germain. Genesis Antwi and Filip Jorgensen continue to provide a strong contribution with both also starting all three games. Samuels-Smith continued his impressive development at Notts County, featuring in five matches across League One and the EFL Trophy. He completed the full 90 minutes in four of those appearances, including the victories over Sheffield Wednesday and Nottingham Forest’s Under-21s, and demonstrated his versatility by featuring at centre-back and on the left of midfield. Murray-Campbell (pictured top) remains an important member of RC Kortrijk’s defence in his first loan spell in senior football. The 20-year-old played in the games against Genk and Standard Liege, with Kortrijk earning a hard-fought point away from home in the latter. October saw Derry make his debut appearance in the UEFA Champions League during the Portuguese side's 2-0 win away to Lens. The winger provided an assist for Sporting Lisbon in their 2-1 victory over Maritimo in the quarter-finals of the Portuguese League Cup. Wilson has been an ever-present for Rochdale this season, with the highlight of his October a clean sheet kept in a battling 1-0 success over Swindon Town at the start of the month. Seventeen-year-old Kavuma-McQueen enjoyed another productive month with Portsmouth, featuring in six Championship fixtures during October. The young winger made his presence felt particularly in the 3-2 victory over Sheffield United, claiming an assist as Pompey secured an important three points. Walsh continues to gain valuable senior experience at Wigan Athletic, featuring in all six of the League One side's October fixtures. He provided an assist in their game against Huddersfield and started both the Latics’ victories during the month, against Reading and Barrow. Emenalo made his senior debut in October as Celtic beat Hearts 7-1. He followed that up by featuring in the draw with Dundee United. Mhueka was also involved in all three Scottish Premiership fixtures. Satpayev returned to action during October following an injury that restricted his involvement in September. The 18-year-old made three appearances for Burnley, taking his total to seven since joining the Championship club on loan. It was an excellent month for Sarr and Real Sociedad. The defender started each of their six fixtures, with four of those won, including three in La Liga. Those victories have seen them rise to fifth in the table. They also picked up their maiden Europa League victory of the campaign, thrashing Lillestrom 6-0 away from home. Having returned from suspension, Disasi started Palace’s Premier League games against Newcastle and Tottenham towards the end of the month. He also played the full 90 minutes in the Eagles’ Europa League fixtures away to Lyon and Besiktas. Badiashile started four matches for Napoli in the heart of defence, including a Champions League defeat at Villarreal and a thrilling 3-3 draw with Roma. Unfortunately, an injury sustained in that game has ruled him out of Napoli’s past two fixtures. Sanchez played twice for Como, starting their Champions League defeat to Feyenoord and 3-1 Serie A victory over Torino. Garnacho saw more involvement for Villa in October, coming off the bench in four games including the Champions League successes at home to Fenerbahce and Viking Stavanger. Harrison has firmly established himself in Wimbledon’s midfield, starting six of their seven appearances in a busy October. He accumulated more than 300 minutes of football in the process. Richards, meanwhile, is currently sidelined through injury. Kiano Dyer continues to feature regularly for Chesterfield in League Two. He made five appearances for the Spireites, who are currently positioned in tenth place. It was a flawless October for Boreham Wood and Curd, who came into the team at the start of the month. He subsequently played each of their five National League games - all of which were won – and kept two clean sheets in the process. They are already 12 points clear at the top of the table. Merrick was in the opposition goal as Boreham Wood won a dramatic game against Hartlepool 4-3 this past weekend. It was the young keeper’s second appearance of the month, following a 2-1 success against Hornchurch. Sands continues to feature regularly between the posts for Dulwich in the Isthmian Premier League, making four appearances as the south London side sit just outside the play-off positions.

news.body_en: Chelsea's final game before the November international break takes us to the North-East of England to play Sunderland. The Blues head to the Stadium of Light fresh off the 2-0 success against Manchester United last weekend. news.title: That’s Proper Chels: Chelsea FC and Chelsea Foundation unite Blues family to support those experiencing loneliness
news.title_zh: 这才是正确的切尔西：切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西基金会联合蓝军大家庭为那些经历孤独的人提供支持
news.body_en:
Chelsea FC and Chelsea Foundation have joined forces for a third consecutive year to support the Blues' local community through the launch of That's Proper Chels. Inspired by classic Christmas shopping channels, the club's 2026 festive campaign sees a cast of familiar faces showcase the gifts, traditions and unmistakable spirit that make Chelsea unique. Underpinning the campaign is a commitment to making a positive difference. A percentage of sales from our festive range will be donated to Chelsea Foundation and its charity partners, helping to fund work that tackles loneliness and social isolation across London and the communities surrounding the club. Since we launched our first festive campaign in 2024, over £280,000 has been granted to organisations tackling homelessness and loneliness in south-west London and Surrey. Funds have come from the sale of festive products in the Stamford Bridge Megastore and online, along with monetary donations from fans, staff and the wider Chelsea community. Supporters have also donated gifts at men’s and women’s matches in the build-up to Christmas, with 3,200 presents given last year alone and distributed to those in need. This year’s campaign is centred around a nostalgic Chelsea TV network, complete with its own shopping segments, special guests and game shows. Designed to recall a time of families gathering around a TV to watch together, and an era when a shopping catalogue was diligently poured over with pages turned down to mark the much-wanted items, there are appeal messages woven throughout to highlight Christmas is a time for giving. View this post on Instagram            
Players from the men’s and women’s teams lead the campaign, with Ellie Carpenter, Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Alyssa Thompson featuring. The campaign launches today across our social media channels and outdoor advertising spots across the city. There are plenty of winter classics available in the merchandise range on sale online and in store, including three designs of Christmas jumper which, based on previous years, are destined to sell out. As well as two patterns in blue, for 2026 we have a seasonal jersey taking its theme from the famous away shirt that shocked when first unveiled three decades ago, with its unmissable tangerine and graphite colouring. To also help wrap up warm, there are Christmas scarves and hats, while the 2026/27 home, away and third kits make perfect gifts for Blues fans everywhere, as does the selection of stocking-fillers we suggest. Click to see the Chelsea festive range Coming soon and a club-first, Chelsea will bring That's Proper Chels to life with a pop-up retail shop in Covent Garden, London's premier shopping destination, throughout the festive period. The store will serve as a home for all things Chelsea, offering supporters a unique Christmas shopping experience in the heart of the capital. Featuring a TV screen-inspired shop window that transports visitors directly into the world of That's Proper Chels, the pop-up will showcase and sell items from our exclusive festive range alongside products featured in the campaign launch. As supporters shop, they will also be helping to make a difference, with a percentage of proceeds from the festive collection donated to Chelsea Foundation and its charity partners to support their work tackling loneliness. Laura Cordingley, CEO Chelsea Foundation, said: ‘Christmas should be a time of connection and togetherness, but we know that for many people in our local community, it can also be a time of loneliness and isolation. At Chelsea Foundation, we believe in the power of our club to bring people together, create a sense of belonging and make a lasting difference to the lives of those around us. ‘Through the That’s Proper Chels festive campaign, profits from the Christmas range will help fund grants that can be awarded to local organisations who are working tirelessly to tackle loneliness, build connections and ensure that people feel supported, not just at Christmas, but throughout the year. ‘Every purchase can help us extend that support to those who need it most. It’s a powerful example of how, together, we can turn pride in our club into positive change in our community.’ In the build-up to Christmas, Chelsea Foundation will host its annual festive lunch at Stamford Bridge, supporting those experiencing loneliness. Supporters will have the opportunity to donate gifts similar to last year at designated drop-off points at all Stamford Bridge matches for both men’s and women's teams, from 14 November. To donate £5 to support those experiencing loneliness this Christmas, please text CFCFOUNDATION to 70085

Chelsea stars named in Premier League Fan Team of the Week
news.title_zh: 切尔西球星入选英超本周最佳球迷团队
news.body_en: Chelsea's impressive 2-0 victory over Manchester United has earned the Blues further recognition, with three of our players selected in the Premier League's Official Fan Team of the Week for Matchweek 9. Estevao Willian, Romeo Lavia and Morgan Rogers have all been included in the fan-selected XI for Matchweek 9 after playing important roles in Saturday's victory over the Red Devils. The Blues returned to winning ways with an excellent display at Stamford Bridge, as second-half goals from Rogers and Cole Palmer secured all three points for Xabi Alonso's side. Rogers broke the deadlock early in the second half with a superb individual effort, collecting Lavia's pass in midfield before driving forward and finding the net. The England international's impressive attacking display earned him a place in the Team of the Week, alongside Lavia, who was instrumental in Chelsea's victory. Our No.45 produced an outstanding all-round performance in the heart of midfield, demonstrating his composure in possession, ability to break up opposition attacks and quality on the ball. The Belgian's influential display also saw him voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App, before claiming the Premier League's Player of the Matchweek award. Estevao completes the Chelsea trio selected by supporters, with the Brazilian winger recognised for his lively attacking performance against United. The 19-year-old was a constant threat with his skill, movement and creativity, helping the Blues secure an important victory in front of the Stamford Bridge faithful. Chelsea's three representatives are joined by players from Arsenal, Aston Villa, Bournemouth, Brighton & Hove Albion and Tottenham Hotspur in the final XI, which was selected by supporters voting on the Premier League's official website. Premier League Official Fan Team of the Week – Matchweek 9 Goalkeeper: Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion). Defenders: Ezri Konsa (Arsenal), Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham Hotspur), Luka Vuskovic (Brighton & Hove Albion), Gabriel (Arsenal). Midfielders: Estevao Willian (Chelsea), Declan Rice (Arsenal), Roméo Lavia (Chelsea), Morgan Rogers (Chelsea). Forwards: Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa), Evanilson (Bournemouth).

news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 埃弗顿：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: We return to Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon when we take on Everton in the Women's Super League. The Blues are currently top of the WSL table on goal difference - sitting on equal points with Manchester City - with our tally helped by our 6-0 victory against Charlton at The Valley last time out. We now prepare to play our fifth game at the Bridge this season when the Toffees visit. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Everton, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Everton takes place on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm UK time. The best way to see the game is to join us at the Bridge! Tickets are still available to purchase here. If you can't make the game in person,  then you can watch the action live on Sky Sports Premier League and Sky Mix. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. After drawing with Aston Villa in our first league game of the campaign, the Blues have since won seven WSL games in a row. This is our best winning streak in the same top-flight season since winning our first nine matches under head coach Sonia Bompastor in 2024/25. We have scored 18 goals across our last four WSL games, netting three times twice and six times twice. The Toffees are eighth in the table after eight games. They have kept three clean sheets this season, only one fewer than they managed across the whole of the 2025/26 campaign (four in 22). Chelsea (five) are the only other side with more than two shutouts in the competition this term. Chelsea have won 16 of our last 18 WSL games against Everton (one draw and one defeat), netting three or more goals in 11 of our last 12 victories. Everton were 1-0 winners in this fixture at Kingsmeadow last season, ending a run of eight consecutive away defeats against Chelsea in the Women’s Super League. The Toffees have never won back-to-back WSL away matches versus the Blues.
news.body_zh: 周六下午我们将返回斯坦福桥，在女子超级联赛中迎战埃弗顿。蓝军目前在 WSL 积分榜上以净胜球优势位居榜首，与曼城积分相同，上一场比赛我们在山谷球场以 6-0 战胜查尔顿，帮助我们取得了进球。我们现在准备在太妃糖队来访时打本赛季在大桥的第五场比赛。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的比赛将于 2026 年 11 月 8 日星期日在斯坦福桥举行，开球时间定于英国时间中午 12 点 45 分。观看比赛的最佳方式就是来到桥上加入我们！门票仍然可以在这里购买。如果您无法亲自观看比赛，则可以在天空体育超级联赛和 Sky Mix 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。在本赛季首场联赛战平阿斯顿维拉后，蓝军已经连续七场赢得 WSL 比赛。这是自 2024/25 年在主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 带领下赢得前九场比赛以来，我们在同一顶级联赛赛季中取得的最佳连胜纪录。在过去的四场 WSL 比赛中，我们打进了 18 个进球，分别进了 3 球、2 球和 6 球。八场比赛过后，太妃糖队在积分榜上排名第八。他们本赛季保持了三场不失球，仅比他们在2025/26赛季整个赛季的表现（22场比赛中的四场）少一场。切尔西（五场）是本赛季唯一一支在比赛中被淘汰两次以上的球队。切尔西在过去 18 场对阵埃弗顿的 WSL 比赛中赢了 16 场（1 平 1 负），在过去 12 场胜利中有 11 场打入 3 个或更多进球。上赛季埃弗顿在金斯梅多的这场比赛中以1-0获胜，结束了女超联赛客场对切尔西的八连败。太妃糖队从未在 WSL 客场对阵蓝军的比赛中连续获胜。

news.title: UEFA Youth League report: Cobham Next Gen 2-3 Flora Tallinn (4-5 aggregate)
news.title_zh: 欧足联青年联赛报告：科巴姆下一代 2-3 弗洛拉塔林（总比分 4-5）
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen exited the UEFA Youth League after a 3-2 defeat to Flora Tallinn. We went ahead within two minutes of both halves but a late penalty sent us out of the competition. Mathis Eboue gave us an early lead with a low, driven finish into the far corner, but Sander Alamaa equalised shortly afterwards, making it 1-1 at half-time. In the second half, we began in similar fashion with Ibrahim Rabbaj putting us back in front with his second touch after coming off the bench. Unfortunately, Flora responded quickly again, this time through Marten Kukkonen. They later took the lead from the penalty spot through Alamaa, ending our European aspirations this term. Flora enjoyed a fast start in the reverse fixture, but today it was Chelsea who set the tone immediately, going ahead within two minutes. Yisa Alao lofted the ball up to Ezenwata who nodded it into the path of Eboue. The Blues winger initially stood up his marker before dropping a shoulder, going down the line and rifling his shot against the post and into the bottom corner. Our lead didn’t last long as Alamaa, who scored a brace in the first leg, pickpocketed Alfie Osborne and went through on goal to equalise. We enjoyed the better chances of the first half and neared our second of the afternoon when Ezenwata played a driven pass across the face of goal. Eboue met it first but miskicked his shot, and the ball subsequently fell to Alao, whose effort was snuffed out by Andero Tatrik. At the interval, the score remained level both on the afternoon and on aggregate. Rabbaj was introduced in the second half, replacing Osborne, and made an instant impact. Eboue proved a threat again down the left wing and cut back towards the penalty spot, where Rabbaj was waiting to tuck home with only his second touch. Unfortunately, Flora got back on level terms eight minutes later through Kukkonen. In the 69th minute, Grimwade picked up the ball on the edge of the box surrounded; he wriggled in and out, dodging at least three Flora defenders, before aiming for the top corner - but his effort sailed just over. Flora Tallinn won a penalty with 12 minutes remaining, which was converted by Alamaa to put the visitors in front. Eboue tried to provide the response, when he cut inside and went for the spectacular, but his strike was off target. Andrew Pennie was played through with limited minutes left on the clock, his shot was hard and low but denied by Flora. There were five minutes of additional time and we pushed for an equaliser, but we couldn’t find the all-important goal. This defeat spells the end of our involvement in this season's UEFA Youth League. Cobham Next Gen visit London rivals Tottenham Hotspur this Sunday at the Lamex Stadium. The game gets underway at 1pm GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. Chelsea (4-3-3): Freddy Bernal; Yisa Alao, Olutayo Subuloye (c), Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46), Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87); Heze Grimwade (Jashayde Greenwood 80), Reggie Watson, Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli; Sol Gordon (Riley Ebho 81), Chizaram Ezenwata, Mathis Eboue (Andrew Pennie 81)Unused subs: Toby Bell, Gabriel Sambou, Isago Silva, Josh HenryScorers: Eboue 2, Rabbaj 47Booked: Ezenwata 36, Alao 38, Watson 59Manager: Harry Hudson Flora Tallinn (4-1-4-1): Andero Tatrik; Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88), Ronald Sammul, Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46); Jaron Silm (Eerik Paltser 68); Denis Zotov (Ron Neltsas 69), Marten Kukkonen, Remo Valdmets, Sander Alamaa; Karl-Tristen Lorenz (Uku Korjus 77)Unused subs: Ron Sebastian Miss, Mark Kukk , Jaan Erik Poldma, Rocco OjaScorers: Alamaa 17, 78, Kukkonen 54Booked: Zotov 4, Lorenz 60, Neltsas 72, Raudsalu 90+3 Manager: Alstaar Andris
news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代在以 3-2 输给弗洛拉塔林后退出欧洲青年联赛。上半场两分钟后我们就取得了领先，但最后时刻的点球让我们退出了比赛。马西斯·埃布埃 (Mathis Eboue) 的一记低射远角为我们取得领先，但桑德·阿拉马 (Sander Alamaa) 不久后扳平比分，半场结束时比分变为 1-1。下半场，我们以类似的方式开始，易卜拉欣·拉巴伊替补出场后的第二次触球让我们重新领先。不幸的是，弗洛拉再次迅速做出了反应，这次是通过马丁·库科宁。随后他们通过阿拉马点球取得领先，结束了我们本赛季的欧洲之旅。弗洛拉在相反的比赛中取得了快速的开局，但今天是切尔西立即定下了基调，在两分钟内取得了领先。伊萨·阿拉奥 (Yisa Alao) 将球传给埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata)，埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 将球点到了埃布埃 (Eboue) 的路线上。这位蓝军边锋一开始站了起来，然后肩膀一沉，沿着底线将球射向门柱，飞入球门底角。我们的领先优势并没有持续太久，首回合梅开二度的阿拉马在扒窃阿尔菲·奥斯本后射门扳平比分。我们享受了上半场更好的机会，并在接近下午的第二场比赛时，Ezenwata 将球传过球门。埃布埃先接球，但射门失误，球随后传给了阿拉奥，后者的射门被安德罗·塔特里克扑出。中场休息期间，下午的比分和总比分都保持持平。下半场拉巴伊替换奥斯本上场，并立即发挥作用。埃布埃在左翼再次证明了威胁，并切向点球点，拉巴伊正在等待第二次触球得分。不幸的是，八分钟后弗洛拉通过库科宁扳平了比分。第69分钟，格里姆韦德禁区边缘得球；他蠕动着进进出出，躲开了至少三名弗洛拉防守队员，然后瞄准了球顶角——但他的射门稍稍高出。弗洛拉·塔林在比赛还剩 12 分钟时赢得点球，阿拉马主罚命中，客队取得领先。埃布埃试图做出回应，他内切并打出精彩的射门，但他的射门偏离了目标。安德鲁·彭尼在比赛还剩有限的时间时，他的射门又硬又低，但被弗洛拉挡出。补时还有五分钟，我们力争扳平比分，但我们没能找到最重要的进球。这场失利意味着我们本赛季青年欧洲联赛的结束。科巴姆下一代将在本周日在美时球场客场挑战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。比赛于格林威治标准时间下午 1 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔； Yisa Alao、Olutayo Subuloye (c)、Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46)、Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87)；赫泽·格里姆韦德（Jashayde Greenwood 80）、雷吉·沃森、迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利；索尔·戈登（莱利·埃博 81）、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马蒂斯·埃布埃（安德鲁·彭尼 81）未上场替补：托比·贝尔、加布里埃尔·桑布、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、约什·亨利得分：埃布埃 2、拉巴杰 47 黄牌：埃森瓦塔 36、阿劳 38、沃森 59 经理：哈里·哈德森 弗洛拉·塔林(4-1-4-1)：安德罗·塔特里克； Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88)、Ronald Sammul、Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46)；杰伦·席尔姆（Eerik Paltser 68）； Denis Zotov（Ron Neltsas 69）、Marten Kukkonen、Remo Valdmets、Sander Alamaa；卡尔-特里斯坦·洛伦茨 (Uku Korjus 77) 未上场替补：罗恩·塞巴斯蒂安·米斯、马克·库克、贾恩·埃里克·波尔德马、罗科·奥哈得分：阿拉马 17、78、库科宁 54 黄牌：佐托夫 4、洛伦茨 60、内尔察斯 72、劳德萨鲁 90+3 经理：阿尔斯塔尔·安德里斯

news.title: Veerle Buurman on the Ballon d'Or and playing in front of Hannah Hampton
news.title_zh: 维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 荣获金球奖并在汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 面前表演
news.body_en: It’s been another strong start to the season for Veerle Buurman. Still only 20, the defender has started nine of our 13 matches this season and looks as assured as players with many more years of experience. At the end of her first campaign with Chelsea, the Dutch international won the Women’s Super League Rising Star Award for her outstanding performances in the backline during 2025/26. Now that she is used to playing in the WSL, she reflected on the strength of the league and picked out her standout moments from her time with the Blues so far. ‘The quality in the whole league, all the teams, is going up,’ she explained. ‘Every weekend there's a big game, and it’s important to take the three points. There’s never an easy game. ‘This is my second season at Chelsea, and winning the Rising Star Award from the WSL was of course really nice. 'I’d also pick out my first goal for Chelsea as another big moment, but being a part of this team means a lot already, and I’m enjoying my football here, being on the pitch with a lot of girls I can learn from.’ Buurman also attended this year’s Ballon d’Or ceremony, having been named on the five-player shortlist for the Women’s Young Talent of the Year award. Barcelona’s Vicky Lopez scooped the trophy on this occasion, but the youngster reflected on how it felt to be named as one of the five best young talents in world football. ‘It meant a lot to be nominated,’ she said. ‘I never expected it, but I was really proud and happy. A lot of the girls came to me to say congratulations when I found out – it was a really nice moment on the pitch before training.’ It must be reassuring for a young defender to be playing in front of a goalkeeper of Hannah Hampton’s calibre. Buurman took the time to praise her Chelsea colleague and explained why she feels so at ease with her as the last line of defence. ‘Hannah is really good,’ she continued. ‘She's showing it on the field in every game in terms of when she's on the line, but also on the ball. Her passing is amazing, and she's showing every season how good she is on the field. ‘If you're playing and you know Hannah is behind you in goal, that's really nice. You feel confident. You know she has your back. She’s making saves, she also has a lot of confidence on the ball, and she's showing that every game.’ It’s not just at Chelsea that Buurman is thriving. She’s already earned 20 caps for the Netherlands and will be at the Women’s World Cup in 2027 should they come through their qualifying double header against Slovenia in early December. ‘Every time you put on the national team shirt, it's something to be really proud of and never gets normal,’ she concluded. ‘We have important games coming up in the next international window. We need to qualify for the World Cup. If we qualify, it will be amazing to be there as a team.’
news.body_zh: 对于 Veerle Buurman 来说，这是本赛季的又一个强劲开局。这位年仅 20 岁的后卫已经在我们本赛季的 13 场比赛中首发了 9 场，看起来和拥有多年经验的球员一样自信。在切尔西的第一个赛季结束时，这位荷兰国脚凭借2025/26赛季在后防线上的出色表现赢得了女超联赛新星奖。现在她已经习惯了 WSL 的比赛，她回顾了联赛的实力，并挑选了迄今为止她在蓝军时期的精彩时刻。 “整个联盟、所有球队的质量都在提高，”她解释道。 “每个周末都有一场重要的比赛，拿下三分很重要。从来没有一场简单的比赛。 “这是我在切尔西的第二个赛季，赢得 WSL 新星奖当然非常棒。 “我还认为我在切尔西的第一个进球是另一个重要时刻，但成为这支球队的一员已经意味着很多，我很享受在这里的足球，在球场上和很多我可以学习的女孩在一起。”布尔曼还参加了今年的金球奖颁奖典礼，被提名为年度女子青年才俊奖的五人候选名单。巴塞罗那队的维琪·洛佩兹这次捧起了奖杯，但这位年轻人反思了被评为世界足坛五名最佳年轻天才之一的感受。 “获得提名意义重大，”她说。 “我没想到会这样，但我真的很自豪和高兴。当我发现这一消息时，很多女孩都来向我表示祝贺——训练前在球场上的那一刻真的很美好。”对于一名年轻的后卫来说，在汉娜·汉普顿这样的门将面前踢球一定会让人感到安心。布尔曼花时间赞扬了她的切尔西同事，并解释了为什么她对她作为最后一道防线感到如此自在。 “汉娜真的很棒，”她继续说道。 “她在每场比赛中都在场上展示了这一点，无论是在罚球线上，还是在控球时。她的传球令人惊叹，每个赛季她都在场上展示着自己的出色表现。 “如果你在比赛时知道汉娜在你身后，那就太好了。你感到自信。你知道她会支持你。她能够做出扑救，她对球也充满信心，她在每场比赛中都表现出了这一点。” 布尔曼不仅仅在切尔西茁壮成长。她已经为荷兰队出场 20 次，如果荷兰队在 12 月初对阵斯洛文尼亚的预选赛双头赛中获胜，她将参加 2027 年女足世界杯。 “每次穿上国家队球衣，你都会感到非常自豪，而且永远不会变得正常，”她总结道。 “我们将在下一个国际比赛窗口进行重要的比赛。我们需要获得世界杯参赛资格。如果我们晋级，作为一个团队来到那里将是令人惊奇的。”

news.title: Marco Palestra: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 马可·帕莱斯特拉：我的足球第一次
news.body_en: After making his full Chelsea debut at the weekend, Marco Palestra shares his earliest memories and experiences in football. The Italian full-back had to wait to make his first start for the Blues, in Saturday's 2-0 win over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, following his summer move from Atalanta, and now he answers our quickfire questions so you can get to know him a little better... What was the first football match you went to? The first match that I remember that I went to see was Atalanta against Palermo in Bergamo. Atalanta lost 1-0, I remember, and I had just joined Atalanta. I was 10 years old, I think. What was the first football kit you owned? I think one of my first jerseys that I had was one of Ronaldinho, a Brazil shirt. I remember that one. What was the first team you played for? The first team I played for was Assago, which is near where I was born. I played there for four years, it was a good time. Who was the first coach who gave you important advice? I can’t remember any specific advice but maybe when I was a bit older, like 16, our coach that changed my position. His name is Marco Fioretto. So he was the first one who moved me from midfield to out wide and he maybe changed my career. Who was your first team-mate who became a friend? I have one of my best friends, his name is Filippo Bonvento. I met him when I started playing at Assago when I was about four years old, and now he is still my best friend. So for sure him. Who was your first professional game against? My debut in professional football isn’t good, because I got a red card. I played for Atalanta Under-23s in the third league, Serie C, and I remember it was a difficult game and I got a red card, so it’s maybe not the best debut. I probably deserved it, it was two yellows because I made two fouls, but I didn’t have any experience at the time. Who was your first goal against? I will always remember my first goal. Again, it was for Atalanta Under-23s in the third league. It was against Albinoleffe, who are local rivals in Bergamo. The game finished 1-1, and I scored the first goal with a header. Can you remember the first time somebody recognised you in public? I don’t know. I think it would have been in Bergamo when I started to play in the third league with the Under-23s, probably around the city one guy recognised me. What was your first emotion when you signed for Chelsea? I was just happy because when I was young I never thought I could be a Chelsea player. So the first emotion was only happiness. Now I am still happy, but I need to improve myself to win with this team.
news.body_zh: 在周末完成切尔西首秀后，马科·帕莱斯特拉分享了他最早的足球记忆和经历。这位意大利边后卫在夏季从亚特兰大转会到斯坦福桥后，必须等到周六在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中才能为蓝军首次首发，现在他回答了我们的快速问题，以便您可以更好地了解他......您去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？我记得我去看的第一场比赛是亚特兰大在贝加莫对阵巴勒莫的比赛。我记得亚特兰大0-1输了，当时我刚刚加盟亚特兰大。我想，当时我10岁。您拥有的第一套足球装备是什么？我想我拥有的第一件球衣是罗纳尔迪尼奥的巴西球衣。我记得那个。你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？我效力的第一支球队是阿萨戈队，它离我出生的地方很近。我在那里打了四年球，那是一段美好的时光。谁是第一个给你重要建议的教练？我不记得有什么具体的建议，但也许当我年纪大一点，比如 16 岁的时候，我们的教练改变了我的立场。他的名字叫马可·菲奥雷托。所以他是第一个把我从中场调到边路的人，他也许改变了我的职业生涯。谁是你第一个成为朋友的队友？我有一个最好的朋友，他的名字叫 Filippo Bonvento。我四岁左右开始在阿萨戈踢球时认识了他，现在他仍然是我最好的朋友。所以肯定是他。你的第一场职业比赛是对阵谁？我的职业足球首秀并不顺利，因为我得到了一张红牌。我在意丙第三级联赛亚特兰大U-23队效力，我记得那是一场艰难的比赛，我得到了一张红牌，所以这可能不是最好的处子秀。我可能活该，因为我犯了两次犯规，所以吃到了两张黄牌，但当时我没有任何经验。你的第一个进球是对阵谁？我将永远记住我的第一个目标。再次，这是第三联赛亚特兰大 23 岁以下青年队的比赛。对手是贝加莫的当地对手阿尔比诺莱夫队。比赛以1-1结束，我头球攻入第一个进球。你还记得第一次有人在公共场合认出你是什么时候吗？我不知道。我想当我开始为 23 岁以下青年队参加第三级联赛时，应该是在贝加莫，可能在城市周围有人认出了我。当你加盟切尔西时，你的第一感觉是什么？我很高兴，因为当我年轻的时候，我从来没有想过我可以成为一名切尔西球员。所以最初的情绪只有幸福。现在我仍然很高兴，但我需要提高自己才能与这支球队一起获胜。

news.title: Romeo Lavia wins Premier League Player of the Matchweek award
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚荣获英超比赛周最佳球员奖
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia has been named the Premier League's Player of the Matchweek following his outstanding performance in Chelsea's 2-0 victory over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge The Belgian midfielder produced an excellent all-round display as the Blues returned to winning ways on Saturday, playing an influential role in the heart of midfield and helping Xabi Alonso's side secure all three points. Lavia's composure in possession, ability to break up opposition attacks and intelligent distribution were key to Chelsea's impressive performance, while he also played an important part in our opening goal. It was the 22-year-old who won possession in midfield before supplying the pass for Morgan Rogers to break the deadlock early in the second half, with Cole Palmer later doubling our advantage from the penalty spot. Having already been voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App, Lavia has now added another individual accolade following a vote by football fans on the Premier League's official website. Our No.45 came out on top in a six-player shortlist that also featured Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, Oli McBurnie, Declan Rice, Jan Paul van Hecke and Bart Verbruggen. Speaking after Saturday's victory, Lavia reflected on the hard work behind his performances. He said: 'I feel very comfortable. Like I've always said, it's been in the weeks a lot of work that goes unseen with everyone in the building, at the training ground. So I'm very happy that it's all paying off and hopefully it just continues this way.' Head coach Alonso was also full of praise for the Belgian following his influential display against United. 'It was a top performance. In the last three weeks, I've seen a Romeo in top form. He is feeling good and feeling confident,' said Alonso. 'His game, from a midfielder's point of view, was very complete. He has done so many good things and I'm happy for him. He deserves huge recognition.' And that recognition has now arrived, with Lavia's latest accolade providing another reason to celebrate an impressive individual performance and an important Chelsea victory.
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚在切尔西在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中表现出色，被评为英超比赛周最佳球员。这位比利时中场在周六蓝军重回胜利之路的过程中展现了出色的全面表现，在中场核心发挥了重要作用，帮助哈维·阿隆索的球队全取三分。拉维亚在控球时的冷静、瓦解对手进攻的能力以及聪明的分配能力是切尔西令人印象深刻的表现的关键，同时他也在我们的首个进球中发挥了重要作用。正是这位 22 岁的球员在中场赢得了控球权，然后在下半场早些时候为摩根·罗杰斯提供传球，打破了僵局，随后科尔·帕尔默在点球点将我们的优势扩大了一倍。拉维亚已经在切尔西官方应用程序上被球迷评选为全场最佳球员，继英超官方网站上球迷投票后，拉维亚又获得了另一项个人荣誉。我们的 45 号球员在六人入围名单中名列前茅，其他入围名单还包括基尔南·杜斯伯里·霍尔、奥利·麦克伯尼、德克兰·赖斯、扬·保罗·范赫克和巴特·维尔布鲁根。周六的胜利后，拉维亚回顾了他的表现背后的辛勤工作。他说：“我感觉很舒服。就像我一直说的那样，这几周以来，大楼里、训练场上的每个人都做了很多看不见的工作。所以我很高兴这一切都得到了回报，并希望它能继续这样下去。”在对阵曼联的比赛中，比利时人的表现很有影响力，主教练阿隆索也对他赞不绝口。 “这是一场顶级表演。在过去的三周里，我看到了罗密欧的最佳状态。他感觉很好并且充满信心，”阿隆索说。 “从中场球员的角度来看，他的比赛非常完整。他做了很多好事，我为他感到高兴。他值得得到巨大的认可。现在这种认可已经到来，拉维亚的最新荣誉为庆祝令人印象深刻的个人表现和切尔西的重要胜利提供了另一个理由。

news.title: WNL Cup Report: Oxford United Women 1-1 Chelsea Women Under-18s (3-4 on pens)
news.title_zh: WNL 杯赛报告：牛津联女足 1-1 切尔西 18 岁以下女足（笔杆 3-4）
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women’s League, reached the second round of the Women’s National League Cup after beating Oxford United Women 4-3 on penalties following a 1-1 draw at the MGroup Stadium. Carla Gardiner (in the picture above) gave the Blues a first-half lead before Oxford levelled shortly before the break. With the score level after 90 minutes, the tie went straight to a shootout, where Victoria Rudz saved Oxford’s fourth penalty and Gabi Storey scored the winning kick. Chelsea competed very well against an Oxford side who are top of the third tier and had not lost in any competition this season. Leanne Champ’s side edged the possession statistics and worked tirelessly throughout. The Blues showed great character and intent to go further in this competition than in previous years. Chelsea went ahead on 27 minutes. Patient combination play around our own box involving Storey, Lola Brown and Keira Johnson ended with the ball returned to Rudz, who went longer into the wide left channel under pressure from an Oxford forward. A mix-up between Oxford’s central midfielder and full-back sent the ball into the air, and Brown capitalised to restart the attack. She drove forward into space with options on either side and picked out Gardiner, who had peeled off to the left. Gardiner took a touch inside the box and unbalanced the Oxford centre-back with quick feet. The defender raised a leg to block, and the shot deflected into the net. Oxford equalised two minutes before half-time. Storey and Chloe Sarwie played short from a Chelsea goal kick to find captain Belle Sullivan centrally, but good Oxford pressure forced the Blues into a mistake, with the Yellows' number 10 slipping her finish across Rudz and into the net. Champ made a double change on the hour, as Aysia Matabaro and Stevie Sinclair replaced Rebekah Pierce and Gardiner. The score remained 1-1 at full-time, and under competition rules the tie went straight to penalties, with Oxford going first. Oxford converted their first three kicks, sending Rudz the wrong way each time. Brown buried Chelsea’s first low into the corner, and Chelsea N’Drin scored straight down the middle, but Sinclair’s effort went just wide of the left post. Rudz read Oxford’s fourth penalty well, saving a slow effort down to her right, and Nelly Las drove low and hard into the corner to level the shootout at 3-3. Oxford’s fifth taker then blasted high over the bar, and Storey stepped up to squeeze a low, hard penalty in past the goalkeeper to send the Blues through. Chelsea are in the draw for the second round of the Women’s National League Cup. The draw takes place at 7pm on Wednesday 4 November and will be shown on the FA WNL YouTube channel. The Blues return to PGA Division 1 action on Wednesday 4 November, when Sunderland travel to Cobham. Chelsea (3-4-3): Victoria Rudz; Chloe Sarwie, Gabi Storey, Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c), Keira Johnson, Chelsea N’Drin, Lola Brown; Rebekah Pierce (Aysia Matabaro 60), Carla Gardiner (Stevie Sinclair 60), Nelly LasUnused subs: Freya Weeks, Annie Boichat, Sophie Leach, Tess Finn, Jahmya PutmanScorers: Gardiner 27Penalties: Brown (scored), N’Drin (scored), Sinclair (missed), Las (scored), Storey (scored)Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在 MGroup 体育场 1-1 战平后，点球大战以 4-3 击败牛津联女子队，进入女子国家联赛杯第二轮。卡拉·加德纳（上图）帮助蓝军在上半场取得领先，随后牛津队在中场休息前不久扳平比分。 90分钟后比分扳平，双方直接进入点球大战，维多利亚·鲁兹扑出牛津队的第四个点球，加比·斯托雷打进致胜一球。切尔西与牛津队的比赛表现出色，牛津队是第三梯队的顶级球队，本赛季在任何比赛中都没有输过。 Leanne Champ 的球队在控球数据上取得了优势，并且自始至终不知疲倦地工作。蓝军表现出了出色的性格，并决心在这场比赛中比往年走得更远。第27分钟，切尔西取得领先。斯托里、洛拉·布朗和凯拉·约翰逊在我们自己的禁区周围进行了耐心的组合比赛，最终球回到了鲁兹，鲁兹在牛津前锋的压力下进入了左路。牛津大学的中场球员和边后卫之间的失误将球传到了空中，布朗利用这一机会重新开始了进攻。她向前驶入太空，两边都有选择，并选中了从左侧脱离的加德纳。加德纳在禁区内触球，快速的脚步使牛津中后卫失去了平衡。防守队员抬腿挡出，射门偏入球网。半场结束前两分钟，牛津队扳平比分。斯托里和克洛伊·萨维在切尔西球门球后短距离找到队长贝尔·沙利文，但牛津队强大的压力迫使蓝军犯了一个错误，黄队的 10 号球穿过鲁兹并入网。钱普在整点做出了两次换人，艾西亚·马塔巴罗和史蒂夫·辛克莱取代了丽贝卡·皮尔斯和加德纳。全场比赛比分仍是1-1，根据比赛规则，双方直接进入点球大战，牛津队先胜。牛津队在前三场比赛中都取得了进球，但鲁兹每次都踢错了方向。布朗将切尔西的第一次低射埋入角球，切尔西的恩德林直接从中路得分，但辛克莱的射门稍稍偏出左门柱。鲁兹（Rudz）很好地解读了牛津队的第四个点球，将一记缓慢的射门扑出右侧，内莉·拉斯（Nelly Las）低位大力射入角球，将点球大战扳成3-3平。牛津队的第五名接球手随后射门高出横梁，斯托里挺身而出，将一记低而重的点球越过门将，帮助蓝军晋级。切尔西已进入女子全国联赛杯第二轮抽签。抽签将于 11 月 4 日星期三晚上 7 点举行，并将在 FA WNL YouTube 频道上播出。蓝军将于 11 月 4 日星期三重返 PGA Division 1 比赛，届时桑德兰将前往科巴姆。切尔西（3-4-3）：维多利亚·鲁兹；克洛伊·萨尔维 (Chloe Sarwie)、加比·斯托里 (Gabi Storey)、佐伊·西卡迪尼 (Zoe Ciccardini)；贝尔·沙利文 (c)、凯拉·约翰逊、切尔西·恩德林、洛拉·布朗；丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Aysia Matabaro 60)、卡拉·加德纳 (Stevie Sinclair 60)、内莉·拉斯未上场替补：弗雷亚·威克斯、安妮·博伊查特、索菲·利奇、泰丝·芬恩、贾米亚·普特曼得分者：加德纳 27 点球：布朗（得分）、恩德林（得分）、辛克莱（失手）、拉斯(得分), Storey (得分) 主教练: Leanne Champ

news.title: Lavia on Hazard: ‘I could see in his eyes he was happy for me’
news.title_zh: 拉维亚谈阿扎尔：“我可以从他的眼睛里看到他为我感到高兴”
news.body_en: Not long after the dust had settled on our win over Manchester United on Saturday, a very special guest waited to greet the Chelsea players before they headed home. Eden Hazard was stationed just outside the tunnel at Stamford Bridge having watched his former club triumph courtesy of goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. Our brilliant former attacker was especially excited to meet Palmer, who now adorns the No.10 shirt with similar skill and verve as Hazard did, but also his compatriots Mike Penders and Romeo Lavia, both of whom had starred in the game. Lavia has enjoyed his start to the campaign, which has included a return to the Belgium national team. He was thrilled to speak to Hazard, a bona fide Chelsea and Red Devils great who he hopes to emulate in time. ‘He’s a very important figure for me,’ said Lavia. ‘We speak quite a lot. It was good to see him out here, and I could see in his eyes he was happy for me and proud. It gives me that extra motivation.’ For Lavia, it has been a season of steady progress. He has been in the matchday squad for every Premier League fixture so far, and last week completed two 90-minute matches in the space of four days. His displays in those games, against Liverpool and Man United, highlighted just what the 22-year-old is capable of. Now he is determined to maintain those levels of performance and his fitness. ‘As long as I feel good, I will do everything possible to help the team get results. I’m feeling good, so I am very happy with my performance. ‘I’m still young and there are a lot of areas I can improve. We try to tick them off during the week. It’s a process. ‘All I can say is the work we are doing with all the people at the club is going well so far. It’s just about keeping it going and hopefully we can continue this way.’ Eden Hazard will be back at the Bridge when Chelsea Legends take on Tottenham on 27 March, with tickets on general sale here now!
news.body_zh: 周六我们战胜曼联的比赛尘埃落定后不久，一位非常特别的客人在切尔西球员回家之前等待着他们。伊登·阿扎尔站在斯坦福桥球员通道外，看着他的前俱乐部凭借摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默的进球取得胜利。我们出色的前攻击手特别高兴见到帕尔默，他现在穿着阿扎尔的 10 号球衣，拥有与阿扎尔相似的技巧和活力，还有他的同胞迈克·潘德斯和罗密欧·拉维亚，两人都曾在这场比赛中担任主角。拉维亚的赛季开局很愉快，其中包括重返比利时国家队。他很高兴能与阿扎尔交谈，阿扎尔是一位真正的切尔西和红魔伟大人物，他希望能及时效仿。 “他对我来说是一个非常重要的人物，”拉维亚说。 ‘我们说了很多话。很高兴在这里见到他，我可以从他的眼睛里看到他为我感到高兴和自豪。这给了我额外的动力。”对于拉维亚来说，这是一个稳步进步的赛季。到目前为止，他已经出现在每场英超比赛的比赛日阵容中，上周在四天内完成了两场90分钟的比赛。他在对阵利物浦和曼联的比赛中的表现凸显了这位 22 岁球员的能力。现在他决心保持这样的表现和健康水平。 ‘只要我感觉良好，我就会尽一切努力帮助球队取得成绩。我感觉很好，所以我对自己的表现很满意。 “我还年轻，还有很多地方可以改进。我们尝试在一周内将它们勾选掉。这是一个过程。 “我只能说，到目前为止，我们与俱乐部所有人一起所做的工作进展顺利。只是要保持下去，希望我们能够继续这样下去。” 当切尔西传奇队于 3 月 27 日迎战托特纳姆热刺队时，阿扎尔将重返蓝桥，门票现已全面发售！

news.body_en: It's been a perfect month for Sonia Bompastor and her Chelsea side, with four wins from four in the Women's Super League and Women's Champions League. Now it is time to pick your standout CFCW strike from October! There are plenty of goals to choose from in October, with the Blues netting 14 times across four matches. We started with a 3-0 away win over West Ham United before the international break, and when our players returned from representing their respective nations, we recorded a memorable 6-2 victory over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. That was followed by a 3-1 win at Crystal Palace the following weekend, and the month concluded with a 2-0 win against Roma in the Women's Champions League at Plough Lane. Which Chelsea goal in October was your favourite? View the shortlisted strikes above and then submit your vote on the Chelsea Official App, where the winner of the award, presented by Constant Contact, will be revealed in the coming days. Sjoeke Nusken started the move for our first strike of the afternoon in Dagenham, sensing a moment's hesitation from West Ham when they took a free-kick in their own half. The German international stole the ball, strode forward and picked out Malard. The number nine received it with her back to goal, but stood strong, turned and stroked her finish into the bottom corner. Doubling our lead against the Hammers was Walsh. The move began with Alyssa Thompson jinking her way towards goal from the left-hand side before playing a short sideways pass for Wieke Kaptein, who then shifted the ball quickly to Walsh. The experienced midfielder used her tried and tested technique from range to lash the ball into the bottom corner to the delight of the travelling fans. James' second goal in our 6-2 win over Spurs at Stamford Bridge was a solo effort as she sprinted forward on the break to take matters into her own hands for the second time in that match. Breaking free of the backpedalling defenders, she burst into the box on the left and used her low centre of gravity to lean backwards and curl a superb shot into the bottom right-hand corner. While James' goal came courtesy of a delicate touch, second-half substitute Nusken scored with a pile-driver of a shot to give the Spurs 'keeper Lize Kop no chance of making a save. Finding space in the box, the midfielder blasted home with pure conviction, putting us firmly in the driving seat. Hamano came on after half-time against Spurs, and she marked her appearance against her former loan club with a stunning swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. The replays showed just how much the ball moved once it had left her foot, and the goal certainly got the Blues fans off their seats at Stamford Bridge. Known more for her instinctive finishes from inside the penalty area, Malard's second entry on this list came from distance. As the space opened up 25 yards out following a Katie McCabe throw-in, Malard found herself in space and unleashed a stunning strike that fizzed past a helpless Pauline Peyraud-Magnin in the Palace goal. news.body_zh: 对于索尼娅·邦帕斯特和她的切尔西队来说，这是完美的一个月，在女子超级联赛和女子冠军联赛中取得了四场胜利。现在是时候挑选 10 月份最出色的 CFCW 罢工了！ 10 月份有很多进球可供选择，蓝军在四场比赛中攻入 14 个进球。在国际比赛日之前，我们客场3-0战胜了西汉姆联队，当我们的球员代表各自的国家队归来后，我们在斯坦福桥以6-2击败了托特纳姆热刺队，取得了令人难忘的胜利。接下来的周末，球队以 3-1 战胜水晶宫，并在本月于普劳巷举行的女子冠军联赛中以 2-0 战胜罗马队结束了这个月的比赛。切尔西十月份的哪个进球是你最喜欢的？查看上面入围的进球，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上提交您的投票，由 Constant Contact 颁发的奖项获奖者将在未来几天内揭晓。斯乔克·努斯肯为我们下午在达格纳姆的第一次进球发起了进攻，他感觉到西汉姆联队在本方半场开出任意球时犹豫了片刻。这位德国国脚断球，大步向前，挑出了马拉德。九号球员背对球门接球，但她坚强地站了起来，转身将球射入球门底角。沃尔什（Walsh）使我们对铁锤队的领先优势扩大了一倍。这一举动始于阿丽莎·汤普森从左侧猛冲向球门，然后向维克·卡普坦进行短侧传球，后者迅速将球传给沃尔什。这位经验丰富的中场球员运用她久经考验的远距离技术将球射入底角，让远道而来的球迷们欣喜不已。我们在斯坦福桥 6-2 战胜热刺的比赛中，詹姆斯的第二个进球是她个人的进球，她在中场休息时向前冲刺，在那场比赛中第二次将比赛掌握在自己手中。她挣脱了后退的防守队员，冲入左侧禁区，利用自己的低重心向后倾斜，将一记精彩的射门打入右下角。虽然詹姆斯的进球来自于细腻的触球，但下半场替补出场的努斯肯一脚大力射门，让马刺队的门将莉泽·科普没有机会扑救。这位中场球员在禁区内找到了空间，以纯粹的信念破门得分，让我们牢牢占据了主导地位。滨野在对阵热刺的比赛中场休息后登场，她在对阵她的前租借俱乐部的比赛中以一记令人惊叹的近 30 码外的转身射门标志着自己的出场。回放显示了球一旦离开她的脚就会移动多少，而这个进球无疑让斯坦福桥的蓝军球迷离开了座位。马拉德因其在禁区内本能的射门而闻名，这份名单上的第二个进球来自远距离射门。凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 掷界外球后，当空间打开 25 码时，马拉德 (Malard) 发现自己处于空间中，并射出一脚惊人的射门，飞过了水晶宫球门内无助的保琳·佩罗·马宁 (Pauline Peyraud-Magnin)。单击此处访问切尔西官方应用程序并立即投票！

news.title: Chelsea and Linglong Tire bring The Famous CFC back to China
news.title_zh: 切尔西携手玲珑轮胎将著名的CFC带回中国
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club and global partner Linglong Tire today announce the latest stop for The Famous CFC. The club, including legendary captain Cesar Azpilicueta, will be in Chengdu, China, from 4-6 December for a special fan event ahead of our Premier League fixture against Liverpool. With support from Linglong Tire, this will be the club’s third visit to China for the Famous CFC, following trips to Shanghai and Chongqing. During those visits, Blues legends Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Gianfranco Zola met Chelsea supporters in China, who always give the club a warm welcome. Joining Chelsea FC in Chengdu will be club legend Azpilicueta, who will spend the weekend meeting supporters and sharing stories from his decorated career in blue. The Famous CFC is Chelsea's global fan engagement programme, created to deepen connections with Blues supporters around the world and bring the club closer to our international fanbase. Since launching in 2023, the programme has visited cities across Asia, North America and beyond, giving fans unique opportunities to celebrate their shared passion for Chelsea. Fans attending The Famous CFC in Chengdu can look forward to: A live watch party for Chelsea's Premier League clash against Liverpool An exclusive Q&A session with Cesar Azpilicueta A special photo opportunity with the Premier League trophy Opportunities to win signed Chelsea merchandise Additional entertainment and fan activities throughout the event Presented alongside Linglong Tire, the event will celebrate the passionate Blues family in China and provide supporters with the chance to come together for an unforgettable weekend with fellow fans. Register your interest in the event by clicking here, with further details to follow soon. T&Cs apply
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部和全球合作伙伴玲珑轮胎今天宣布了 The Famous CFC 的最新站点。包括传奇队长塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔在内的俱乐部将于 12 月 4 日至 6 日在中国成都参加一场特别的球迷活动，在我们对阵利物浦的英超联赛之前。在玲珑轮胎的支持下，这将是俱乐部继上海和重庆之后，第三次代表CFC访华。在这些访问期间，蓝军传奇人物吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和吉安弗兰科·佐拉会见了中国的切尔西球迷，他们始终对俱乐部表示热烈欢迎。俱乐部传奇人物阿兹皮利奎塔将在成都加盟切尔西足球俱乐部，他将在周末与球迷会面，并分享他辉煌的蓝色职业生涯的故事。 Famous CFC 是切尔西的全球球迷参与计划，旨在加深与世界各地蓝军支持者的联系，拉近俱乐部与国际球迷的距离。自 2023 年启动以来，该计划已访问亚洲、北美及其他地区的城市，为球迷提供了独特的机会来庆祝他们对切尔西的共同热情。在成都参加 The Famous CFC 的球迷可以期待： 切尔西对阵利物浦的英超联赛现场观看派对 与塞萨尔·阿兹皮利奎塔的独家问答环节 与英超奖杯合影的特别机会 有机会赢得切尔西签名商品 整个活动期间的其他娱乐和球迷活动 与玲珑轮胎一起举办，该活动将庆祝中国热情的蓝军大家庭，并为支持者提供与其他球迷一起度过难忘周末的机会。请点击此处注册您对该活动的兴趣，更多详细信息即将发布。条款与条件适用

news.title: OTD: The Blues run riot in Rome
news.title_zh: OTD：蓝军在罗马发生骚乱
news.body_en: A new-look Chelsea team announced their European credentials with a 4-0 thrashing of Lazio on this day in 2003. The Blues, with plenty of exciting new players in the side, had started our second Champions League campaign solidly, if unspectacularly. We had bagged a late winner against Sparta in Prague before losing at home to Besiktas. A come-from-behind victory against Lazio followed at Stamford Bridge before the teams reconvened in Rome a fortnight later. Nearly 50,000 people packed inside the Stadio Olimpico, including several thousand travelling Chelsea supporters. They witnessed a masterclass from Claudio Ranieri's side. Hernan Crespo, a serial scorer in Serie A before his move to Chelsea, bundled us ahead on the quarter-hour mark, and our cause was made easier early in the second half when Sinisa Mihajlovic was eventually dismissed. We made our numerical advantage count in style, picking off the Roman side with three goals in ten minutes. Eidur Gudjohnsen, Damien Duff and Frank Lampard were the scorers, sealing a victory that made Europe sit up and take notice. We would eventually reach the semi-finals before being agonisingly knocked out by Monaco. You can watch highlights of the famous Lazio win and the story of a memorable second Champions League campaign below.
news.body_zh: 2003 年的这一天，一支面貌焕然一新的切尔西队以 4-0 击败拉齐奥队的方式宣布了他们的欧洲资格。蓝军拥有大量令人兴奋的新球员，尽管表现并不引人注目，但他们已经稳健地开始了我们的第二次欧冠之旅。我们在布拉格对阵斯巴达的比赛中取得了最后的胜利，然后又在主场输给了贝西克塔斯。随后在斯坦福桥逆转战胜拉齐奥，两周后两队在罗马重聚。奥林匹克体育场内挤满了近 5 万人，其中包括数千名随队而来的切尔西球迷。他们见证了克劳迪奥·拉涅利的大师级表演。埃尔南·克雷斯波（Hernan Crespo）在转会切尔西之前是意甲联赛的连续得分手，他在四分之一小时内将我们领先，下半场初期，当西尼萨·米哈伊洛维奇（Sinisa Mihajlovic）最终被罚下时，我们的目标变得更加容易。我们以风格发挥了人数优势，在十分钟内以三个进球击败了罗马队。埃杜尔·古德约翰森、达米安·达夫和弗兰克·兰帕德是进球者，他们锁定了一场让欧洲刮目相看的胜利。我们最终进入了半决赛，然后被摩纳哥痛苦地淘汰了。您可以在下面观看拉齐奥著名胜利的精彩集锦以及令人难忘的第二次欧冠联赛的故事。
